narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On January 23, 2024, at approximately 1030 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a hardware store in Wyoming, Michigan. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and that he has no immigration documents.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he first entered the United States in 2010 near Sasabe, Arizona, and lived in Tucson until 2016, when he returned to Sonora to care for his mother.
The subject stated that he last entered on 09/09/2018, walking through the desert near Lukeville, Arizona.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
